_about: Public-domain Willis Duke Weatherford (1875-1970), YMCA student secretary for the South and founder of the Blue Ridge assembly, for the Word Hoard: Fundamental Religious Principles in Browning's Poetry, Negro Life in the South, Introducing Men to Christ, Personal Elements in Religious Life, and Christian Life a Normal Experience. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 102 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

weatherford-browning: Fundamental Religious Principles in Browning's Poetry (Smith & Lamar, agents , Publishing house of the M. E. church, South, 1907)
weatherford-negro-life: Negro life in the South, present conditions and needs (New York, Young Men's Christian Association Press, 1910)
weatherford-introducing-men: Introducing men to Christ : fundamental studies (New York : Association Press, 1911)
weatherford-personal-elements: Personal elements in religious life (Nashville, Tenn. ; Dallas, Tex. : Publishing House Methodist Episcopal Church, South, 1916)
weatherford-christian-life: Christian life a normal experience : a study in the reality and growth of Christian experience (New York : Association Press, 1919)

_excluded.weatherford-later: The Negro from Africa to America (1924, history) and books after 1930
_excluded.weatherford-edited: Present Forces in Negro Progress and Interracial Cooperation (several authors)
